observations.behavior: Adds a frozen dataclass ExperimentRef with id, team_id, created_by_id fields.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a typed, immutable reference to an experiment, including the creator, for use in downstream checks. This could support access control or audit trails.

observations.behavior: Adds a new module pulse.py with existing_experiment_ids, which filters experiments by team and returns their IDs, including deleted and archived ones.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared, reusable query for Pulse to resolve experiment IDs. This could help avoid repeated query duplication and support deduplication or caching.

observations.behavior: Adds a new module reminders.py with get_experiment_ref, which returns an ExperimentRef or None, including deleted experiments, while preserving team and creator identity.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a typed, team-scoped reference to an experiment, including the creator, for use in downstream checks. This could support access control or audit trails.
